title: Preserve back navigation after opening recent sessions

observation: Repository is on `main` after PR merges, with an unrelated existing modification in `apps/mobile/ios/Podfile.lock`; created branch `fix/session-back-navigation` and should avoid staging the Podfile.lock change.

Opening a recent session from Home uses `router.replace("/session")` after `openPreviousSession`/`openNewSessionFromHistory` succeeds, which replaces the Home route and prevents swipe/back navigation to the previous screen.

Other user-initiated session-open flows also use `router.replace("/session")`: Workspace `Open new session` and Stored Sessions `Continue`. These should push the Session page if the expected mobile behavior is returning to the prior navigation page.

The ActiveSessionScreen guard uses `router.replace("/")` when no active session exists, which is a redirect/fallback and should remain a replace rather than adding an invalid session page to the back stack.

title: Change successful user-initiated session openings to push Session instead of replace
